title: Length of a word of encoded cells
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine, let $f$ assign a cell value to each natural number, and let $m$ be a natural number. The word formed by concatenating the encodings of $f(0),\ldots,f(m-1)$ has length $Wm$, where $W$ is the cell-code width for $N$.
hypotheses_covered: function f from natural numbers to cell values
